confirmedFindings.title: Unremoved event listener retains request context closure causing heap exhaustion
confirmedFindings.body: Attaching an event listener to singleton telemetryBus inside request middleware without cleanup on response close retains request scope closures and leads to heap exhaustion.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Unregister the listener on res.on("finish") or res.on("close") using telemetryBus.off or telemetryBus.removeListener.
